Sam: heads up — canary VM pool after the model switch to textgen-v2 shows a consistent RSS increase. 512-token synthetic runs went from ~6.2GiB -> ~9.1GiB per worker on average. :thinking:
Lina: :eyes: can you paste the pmap/smaps dump? also which allocator build (jemalloc/custom)?
Sam: running on our jemalloc build (jemalloc-5.3 patched). quick pmap for one PID attached below, will grab full smaps if useful:
Sam: ```
$ pmap -x 12345 | tail -n 5
12345:   9123456K total
writeable/private: 321456K
...
RSS: 9301120K
```
Joel: that RSS delta is big. do we know if it's hot-kv cache growth or allocator fragmentation? any change in kvcache size/config in the rollout?
Sam: no config changes intentionally. KV cache hitrate did improve (good), but we didn't bump max_entries. suspect fragmentation around small allocs after quant changes.
Marta: can you run jemalloc stats and epoch? try:
Marta: ```
echo 1 > /proc/12345/oom_score_adj  # (jk)
echo "epoch" > /proc/12345/jeprofctl  # (pseudo)
# real: use mallctl in a small debug binary, or run: jeprof --text /proc/12345
```
Lina: also grab extent stats: mallctl "stats.arenas.0.allocated" and "stats.arenas.0.metadata_allocated". if fragmentation, metadata spikes.
Sam: running a quick jemalloc dump now, will post. pinging @Mike for context — you saw related bump on nightly LTS canaries?
Mike: saw a small uptick yesterday on some runs, thought it was noise. I haven't correlated to quant changes. I can run an allocator-heavy microbench later today. :+1:
infra-bot: Canary deploy textgen-v2 completed 2026-07-12T09:14:21Z — 12 instances, health ok, but memory anomaly flagged on 4/12.
Sam: posted jemalloc output: ```
arenas.total: 64
stats.allocated: 9500000000
stats.active: 9800000000
stats.metadata: 120000000
large.allocated: 1000000000
```
Joel: metadata 120MB seems elevated. could be per-arena metadata leak if arenas count increased. Are we enabling background thread for arenas?
Marta: check MALLOC_CONF — if "narenas:" changed or defaulted higher, that scales metadata. Also "background_thread:true" can change behavior for defrag.
Sam: MALLOC_CONF on canary: "narenas:32,background_thread:true,lg_chunk:21"
Lina: narenas 32 * metadata_per_arena could explain 120MB. try a quick experiment on a single canary: set MALLOC_CONF="narenas:8" and rerun benchmark to see delta. If that helps, we can roll a canary with reduced arenas.
Mike: agree. also try running with MALLOC_CONF="jsmalloc:0" (no transparent huge pages?) — not exactly but check lg_chunk change effect.
Joel: another quick check: enable jemalloc purge sweep interval or call mallctl("arena.<i>.purge") periodically to see recovered memory. If purge recovers a lot, fragmentation/dirty pages are culprit.
Sam: queued a canary rebuild with narenas:8 and same load, starting in 10m. I'll paste numbers.
Sam: quick note — if KV cache uses thread-local caches that grew with arenas, lowering arenas might increase contention. we need to watch latency.
Marta: good call. run 1) memory-only synthetic, 2) latency synthetic, 3) production traffic shadow. compare RSS + p95 latency.
Sam: results from canary with narenas:8 (single run): RSS median -> 6.8GiB (was 9.1GiB), p95 latency +2% (within SLA).
Lina: promising. can you run a few repeats and capture jemalloc stats again?
Sam: running 3 repeats now; if consistent I'll open a small rollout PR to set MALLOC_CONF in canary pool to 8 and add a telemetry check for per-arena metadata.
Mike: if this is the fix, let's also add a note in runtime docs about arena tuning for 64-core hosts. pin to 8 for our instance sizes until we have auto-config heuristics.
Joel: also create a micro-benchmark that simulates smallalloc pattern from KV cache so we don't regress later. Add it to eng-runtime perf jobs.
Sam: will do. action items: 1) Sam: open rollout PR + perf job (ETA 2h) 2) Joel: add microbench harness (ETA EOD) 3) Marta/Lina: verify jemalloc purge hooks and telemetry (ETA EOD)
Marta: I'll add mallctl probes to our debug binary so we can query per-arena metadata remotely.
Sam: thanks all — will update thread with PR link. :thumbsup:
Mike: thanks, great triage. :clap:
Sam: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/4821 (canary MALLOC_CONF change) — reviews welcome @Joel @Lina
Joel: leaving review comments now. main suggestion: add a toggle and document perf tradeoffs.
Sam: merged canary change after minor tweaks, rolling to remaining pool. keeping this thread open for 24h to watch for regressions.
Lina: noted. add a short note to eng-runtime runbook about "narenas" impacts.
Sam: done — runbook updated: https://wiki/internal/eng-runtime/malloc-tuning
Marta: closing loop: jemalloc metrics now reported, will alert if metadata > 150MB for pool.
Sam: closing — no further anomalies after 12h. thanks everyone.
